summary: Iteration 17 tested pending-balance and admin dues regressions across backend + frontend source/UI checks. Backend API behavior matched required rules for active/expired/no-subscription states, role authorization, dues dedupe, and non-mutation. Frontend source wiring for pending balance card/testIDs and Admin ‘Pending Balance’ labeling is present; login UI smoke loaded successfully on mobile viewport.

issues: pending-balance-recharge button minHeight is 40 (<44 touch-target guideline).

action_items: Increase pending-balance-recharge touch target to minimum 44px height for mobile accessibility.
Optional hardening: align frontend API base usage to protected EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming to avoid env-key drift (api.ts currently uses expoConfig.extra.backendUrl / EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL).

frontend/src/api.ts does not directly use EXPO_BACKEND_URL key referenced by platform testing rules; this can cause deployment/config mismatch risk.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested source/login-smoke checks (authenticated UI flow intentionally not executed)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ITER17-scoped users/plans/subscriptions in test fixture and cleaned them in teardown. Used ephemeral local JWTs only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md first. /app/auth_testing.md is absent in workspace. This run intentionally avoided interactive OTP login per safety note. WhatsBoost external messaging stayed MOCKED/untouched for this scope (no live send triggered by tested read endpoints).
rca_of_issue: No functional backend defect found in requested scope. Pending-balance and admin dues logic work as intended: active subscription short-circuits to clear, latest expired drives due amount from current plan price, and dues report de-duplicates by latest expired subscription for users without active plans while preserving data immutability on reads.
